description: This file defines an abstract class 'StreamHandshakeToken' and its derived sealed classes 'StartToken' and 'DeliveryToken' used for stream handshake tokens within Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes methods for creating tokens and equality checks.

classes.name: StreamHandshakeToken
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a handshake token used in Orleans streaming, supporting equality comparison and token creation.

classes.name: StartToken
classes.description: A sealed class representing a start handshake token, derived from StreamHandshakeToken.

classes.name: DeliveryToken
classes.description: A sealed class representing a delivery handshake token, derived from StreamHandshakeToken.

methods.name: CreateStartToken
methods.description: Creates a new StartToken instance with the provided StreamSequenceToken.

methods.name: CreateDeliveyToken
methods.description: Creates a new DeliveryToken instance with the provided StreamSequenceToken.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this token and another StreamHandshakeToken.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.Equals to compare with any object.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the token's type and StreamSequenceToken.
